evidence.quote: Take one RYBELSUS or OZEMPIC tablet orally once daily on an empty stomach in the morning with water (up to 4 ounces of water).
After taking RYBELSUS or OZEMPIC tablets, wait at least 30 minutes before eating food, drinking beverages or taking other oral medications [see Clinical Pharmacology ( 12.3 )] .
Take 1 RYBELSUS or OZEMPIC tablet by mouth on an empty stomach in the morning with water (no more than 4 ounces).
After 30 minutes, you can eat, drink, or take other oral medicines.

response.reasoning: The claim states the medication should be taken with breakfast, but the label explicitly states it must be taken on an empty stomach and that patients must wait at least 30 minutes before eating food.
